# geocode frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geocodeFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The geocoding reference frame in which this code is expressed. Functional: a geocode is expressed in exactly one frame.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) from [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md), [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single geocoding frame a code is expressed in; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it and avoid mixing two systems on one [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md); conversion to WGS84 is a solver computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Examples

- ex:plusLoc [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFramePlusCode`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFramePlusCode.md).
